claims.statement: Meta documents a System User Access Token, generated in Business settings for a system user, that lets an app take automated actions on Ad objects or Pages without an app user or re-authentication.

sources.supports: System User access tokens let your app perform programmatic, automated actions on Ad objects or Pages without requiring input from an app user or re-authentication.
sources.locator: Access Tokens for Meta Technologies, System User Access Tokens

claims.statement: Meta documents that a system user access token is returned by a POST to the SYSTEM-USER-ID/access_tokens endpoint (the response returns the access token string), and that refreshing an expiring system user access token returns it as the access_token member of the oauth/access_token response. This is recorded for the system user access token only.

sources.supports: The response returns the access token string.
sources.locator: Install Apps, Generate, Refresh, and Revoke Tokens, Install Apps (generate request and response)
Install Apps, Generate, Refresh, and Revoke Tokens, Refresh Access Token, sample response

openQuestions.question: Only existence is established. The access-tokens page states that token length changes over time and gives no format grammar; it is not recorded here.

The pages read state how a system user access token is returned or refreshed (it is also copied from Business settings), not an Authorization header or query parameter form for a later request; none is recorded.
The generation sample on the page shows an access_token value that is not recorded here: a sample value is not a format statement.
